images.inspection: Opened complete image with view_image detail=original at its native dimensions.
findings: Neet has a connected full narrow torso, fine grounded legs, projecting muzzle, broad triangular ears and tiny nub. Buddy has four individually traceable limbs, a continuous foreshortened torso and a lowered head directed toward the bowl; the front-right paw is partly occluded by the bowl rather than detached.

Both gray bandanas are dry and clean. Neet lifts his chin while Buddy attends to water, matching the actual pre-event state. Bunting and hurdles establish the park without introducing later ribbons or mud.

Broad smooth tan and charcoal planes retain short body coats. Furnished strands remain regional on Buddy ears, brows, muzzle and distal feet; there is no raised torso shag. Slight pale fringe at the tapered tail tip does not enlarge it into a brush or plume.
Ground shadows, bowl perspective and separated silhouettes are coherent; the differing intentions read immediately. No material anatomy, continuity, setting or finish defect found.

images.inspection: Opened complete image with view_image detail=original at its native dimensions.
findings: Buddy has a continuous moderately elongated trunk, attached neck and substantial limbs with genuine clearance. Two hind paws and the rearward forepaw support him on the beam; the forward forepaw is reaching down toward its top. Limb roots and overlaps remain legible without a duplicated limb.

Neet stands separately at the far end with fine legs, full narrow trunk, broad ears and visible nub. Beam occlusion hides portions of his rear feet consistently with depth; Buddy is higher because he is on the beam, not because of identity-scale drift.
Tunnel, nose dirt, matching dry bandanas and waiting Neet agree with the precise moment after the tunnel and before the pool. Neet has a closed mouth, supporting the silent-encouragement joke.

Low-contrast surface grain appears in the sky, wood and broad coat planes; it does not form raised curls, directional long strands or a shaggy body contour. Regional muzzle, brows and ears remain furnished. This is acceptable paper/watercolor texture, not material fur-length drift.
Beam supports and perspective are coherent, paw placement remains within the beam width, and the cautious movement contrasts clearly with Neet waiting. No material defect found.

images.inspection: Opened complete image with view_image detail=original at its native dimensions.
findings: Buddy rests on a connected chest and torso with two extended forelegs and clearly folded near hindquarter; the far hind limb is naturally occluded. Neet stands independently with four grounded limbs, fine legs, full trunk, projecting muzzle, broad ears and tiny nub. Buddy tail passes behind Neet feet without becoming a fifth limb.

Buddy retains smooth charcoal torso planes with only regional face, ear and foot furnishings. His dark resting tail tapers with modest fringe. Neet coat remains smooth; no added curls, raised torso tufts or woolly volume.

Muddy Buddy paws, dark wet patches on both gray bandanas, two loose prize ribbons and the banyan setting all agree with the closing scene. Neet mouth is open while Buddy closes his eyes, conveying the unwelcome training discussion before Neet lies down.

The shade, ground contact, unobstructed ribbons and alternating standing/resting silhouettes make the payoff clear. No agility equipment intrudes into the return scene. No material anatomy, continuity, setting or finish defect found.
